messages:
kai (prod-ops): Quick update: we're kicking off a controlled capacity wave for RTX-9500 dedicated pools across EU and APAC to relieve backlog and rebalance utilization.
ben (infra): Wave 1 targets: AMS, FRA, SIN, TOK. Move ~40 devices total (20->APAC, 20->EU). We'll do rolling activation over 6h windows per region.
ella (eng-sre): Ops note: yesterday we saw a transient scheduling regression in AMS during a smaller internal test (10m impact). Root cause: scheduler race when draining >8 nodes simultaneously. Fix merged; deploy v2 scheduled in 30m.
chris (sales): Any customer-facing policy changes? need to tell reserved tenants.
kai (prod-ops): Yes — two temporary policy changes for the capacity wave: 1) Reservation priority bump for existing reserved customers (auto-prioritize older reservations by age). 2) Soft-burst cap introduced: max burst = 3x baseline for 20m per workspace, then rate-limit. This is preview-only and will be communicated.
marco (finance): Pricing adjustment: provisional per-unit discount for scalewave allocations: -7% applied to dedicated.rtx9500.<region>.units for bookings that use wave capacity. Finance approved for 30 days for utilization validation.
deploy-bot: rollout started: rtx-9500-wave1-ams v2.0 -> in-progress (2170123460)
ella (eng-sre): Escalation path: if queue depth > 2000 requests for 10m or p99 latency degrades >30% from baseline, rollback wave and notify @ben/@kai.
ben (infra): Technical note: kernel/driver image pinned to 535.110 for the wave. If you see CUDA mismatch, run `kubectl -n infra logs <driver-pod> | grep CUDA`. Share outputs.
billing-bot: note: provisional SKU mapping updated for wave allocations: dedicated.rtx9500.wave1.<region>.units. Billing will reflect discount tag 'wave-discount-v1'.
chris (sales): I'll prepare an internal FAQ for pilot customers listing priority changes, soft-burst limits, and discount details.
kai (prod-ops): TL;DR: Controlled RTX-9500 capacity wave upcoming for EU/APAC, transient scheduling fix deployed, temporary reservation + burst policies, provisional discount for wave users. We'll post an after-action in 24h with utilization numbers. Ping me on regressions. :triangular_flag_on_post:
